methodology.b3: same-current-industry leader-break proxy + low-base/volume filters; leader-health gate: signal close drawdown from 10-session closing high <=15%, close >= MA5, next-session open >= prior MA5 and overnight gap > -5%; next-open follower entry; -5% stop, partial +10% target and short time/MA exits
methodology.trend: C.3/C.4 price/volume breakout proxy only; next-open entry; -8% initial stop and 20-day/platform exit; no fundamental screen
methodology.universe: rows outside listing/delisting dates and recorded historical ST intervals excluded; current name marker stripped to avoid excluding a security from all prior years
methodology.industry: current TuShare stock_basic industry used as a proxy, not historical WJ theme membership
methodology.limit_up: official historical stk_limit up_limit used when available; pct_chg threshold fallback only where that field is absent
methodology.portfolio: separate branch portfolios; max 10 positions each
methodology.benchmark: CSI All Share index 000985.CSI daily returns from index_benchmark_000985_CSI_2016_2025.csv; first backtest date starts at that session close
methodology.mainline_labels: weekly labels and fundamental criteria not used for selection because historical security/theme mapping and point-in-time fundamentals are unavailable
